title: Correlation vs. Causation Explained — Why Patterns Can Mislead Us
skills: identify when patterns do not establish cause-and-effect relationships
recognize misleading reasoning based on association alone
alignment_note: Explains the difference between correlation and causation and why observed patterns do not necessarily prove cause and effect. Supports critical thinking, argument analysis, research literacy, evidence evaluation, and identification of faulty causal reasoning across high school English courses.
